This fruit plot is small, and I mostly manage it with my family. For this season I will use manure or compost if I can get it, but I will not buy much chemical fertilizer because it is costly and often comes late. I will keep using the local planting material I know, and I do not expect to spray chemicals or irrigate because this plot depends on the rain.
